mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_import_backup (id,task_id,record_id,field_values,expires_at,created_by,updated_by) VALUES (#{id},#{taskId},#{recordId},CAST(#{values} AS jsonb),#{expiresAt},NULL,NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,task_id,record_id) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_io_task SET snapshot_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId}), snapshot_expires_at=(SELECT MIN(expires_at) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{taskId}
UPDATE forge_import_backup SET deleted=true,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted
UPDATE forge_io_task SET snapshot_count=0,snapshot_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND snapshot_count > 0
